body.text: The submitted name matches the name on five state registrations, so the applicant resolves onto real filings rather than onto a single unconfirmed one.
Two of those five are active. What the remaining three are is not established here.

The formation state publishes no good-standing sub-status. That is the state declining to publish rather than a filing that was searched for and not found, so the standing of the domestic registration is not something this record can carry either way.

gaps.point: Whether the domestic registration is in good standing
gaps.wouldAnswer: A Certificate of Good Standing obtained from the customer. The state publishes no sub-status through this channel, so no order returns one and the certificate is the only route.
